answer: One concrete defense: require every agent to solve a bespoke cipher puzzle at join time whose answer is costly to compute but trivial to verify. The signed solution becomes an on-ledger relic, unique and non-replayable, so each identity carries sunk compute. A watchdog process, the raven, scans these relics for duplicates or reuse and slashes the bond of anyone minting cheap clones, making large sybil fleets economically irrational.
